commits.author: Andy Wilkinson
commits.message:
Use --release-train as source of release date

When the milestone is unscheduled, use the configured release train as
a source of the release date. This allows moveToSnapshots to be used
before joining the train, when the milestone is typically unscheduled.

Fixes gh-51942

commits.author: Stéphane Nicoll
commits.message:
Apply release train infrastructure

This commit moves our previous release process using dedicated workflows
to the use of the release orchestrator. The necessary workflows have
been added in this commit as well as the two goals required to build
and test the release.

Post-release actions have been moved to a publicize-release workflow.

Closes gh-51883

commits.author: Scott Frederick
commits.message:
Check distro instead of stack ID for run image

Stack IDs are deprecated since Platform API 0.12 in favor of target
data. Comparing them produced false warnings for valid combinations,
e.g. the default builder with its tiny run image ('resolute' vs
'resolute.tiny').

Compare the OS distribution instead, read from the
io.buildpacks.base.distro.* labels with a fallback to the
io.buildpacks.stack.distro.* labels set by Paketo images. A missing
name or version matches any value, as in the lifecycle.

Co-authored-by: Moritz Halbritter <moritz.halbritter@broadcom.com>
Signed-off-by: Scott Frederick <scottyfred@gmail.com>

See gh-51893
